info.description: Machine-readable OpenAPI spec for Buildin V2 API.

bearerAuth.description: Buildin integration token or OAuth access token

email.description: Present only when the token also has `users.email.read`; otherwise `null`.

color.description: Legacy single-channel color. Use text_color and background_color for lossless formatting.

text_color.description: Text color. default clears the text-color channel.

background_color.description: Background color. default clears the background-color channel.

properties.description: Page properties. For database rows, keys must be the database property display names returned by createDatabase/getDatabase, for example `课程名称` or `星期`; do not use the createDatabase request keys or the generic page key `title` unless that is the actual database property name.

upload_url.description: Presigned URL used by the client to upload bytes.

oss_name.description: Internal object key returned after upload-url allocation. Use this value when creating internal file, image, audio, or video blocks.

file_url.description: Deprecated compatibility CDN URL. Prefer oss_name for new integrations.

size.description: Original file size in bytes. This value is required as file.size when creating internal file, image, audio, or video blocks.

headers.description: Headers to send with the PUT upload. Do not add a manual Content-Length header; let the HTTP client compute it from the file bytes.

url.description: Temporary authenticated URL for the requested file.

oss_name.description: Internal object key for this file variant.

ttl.description: Number of seconds for which the returned URLs are valid.

display_mode.description: Code presentation mode. split and preview are supported for Mermaid blocks; other languages use source. Defaults to split for Mermaid and source otherwise.

color.description: Legacy single-channel color. Use text_color and background_color for lossless formatting.

text_color.description: Text color. default clears the text-color channel.

background_color.description: Background color. default clears the background-color channel.

url.description: Temporary file URL returned in API responses.

oss_name.description: Internal object key from /v2/files/upload-url. Prefer this when creating internal file, image, audio, or video blocks.

content_type.description: Original MIME type. Used to infer file display when the object key extension is ambiguous.

size.description: Original file size in bytes. Required when oss_name is provided for internal file, image, audio, or video blocks.

width_mode.description: Table column layout. adaptive fits equal-width columns to the standard page content width; fixed uses the stored/default column widths.

parent.description: Optional. If omitted, the page is created in the current authenticated workspace root.

properties.description: Page properties. For database rows, keys must be the database property display names returned by getDatabase; unknown property names are rejected.

parent.description: Optional. If omitted, the database is created in the current authenticated workspace root.

DatabaseMutationRequest.description: Non-destructive database changes executed in one transaction. Use PropertySchema.id to rename an existing property; omitting id adds or reuses a property by name.

content_type.description: Supported MIME type whitelist enforced by the upload URL endpoint.

content_length.description: File size in bytes. Maximum is 100 MB.

parent.description: Upload destination context. The current implementation accepts only page parents and checks write permission for the provided page_id.

post.description: Returns a presigned upload target plus `oss_name` and `size`. Use the returned `method` and `headers` for the subsequent upload request; do not add a manual `Content-Length` header because HTTP clients should compute it from the file bytes. Treat the upload as successful only after the storage request returns a 2xx status, then pass both `oss_name` and `size` when creating internal file, image, audio, or video blocks; `size` is required for internal file blocks. `file_url` is kept only for compatibility and must not be used as an external file block URL. The current implementation accepts only a writable `parent.page_id`, supports the documented MIME type whitelist, and rejects declared files larger than 100 MB.

200.description: Upload URL and internal object key
